riskLevels.name: High
riskLevels.definition: Severe privacy concerns: the policy permits practices that expose users to significant harm, with little or no user control.

riskLevels.name: Medium
riskLevels.definition: Moderate privacy concerns: potentially intrusive practices are present but are limited, disclosed, or accompanied by opt-outs.

riskLevels.name: Low
riskLevels.definition: Privacy-friendly: practices are limited to what is necessary, transparently disclosed, and give users meaningful control.

riskLevels.name: Unknown
riskLevels.definition: The policy does not address this category, or the text is too ambiguous to assess.

categories.name: Data Collection & Use
categories.definition: What personal data the service collects and how it uses that data for its own purposes.

anchors.High: Collects sensitive data (e.g. precise location, health, biometric) beyond what the service needs, or uses personal data for advertising/profiling by default.
anchors.Medium: Collects standard account and usage data for personalization or analytics; some uses can be limited via settings.
anchors.Low: Collects only data needed to provide the service; uses are clearly described and limited to operating and improving the service.

categories.name: Third-Party Sharing & Selling
categories.definition: Whether personal data is shared with, sold to, or monetized through third parties.

anchors.High: Sells personal data or shares it with data brokers/advertisers for their own use.
anchors.Medium: Shares data with categories of partners (e.g. analytics, advertising); opt-out or 'do not sell' controls are offered.
anchors.Low: Sharing is limited to processors/service providers acting on the service's behalf, or to legal requirements.

categories.name: Data Storage & Security
categories.definition: How long personal data is retained and how it is protected.

anchors.High: No retention limits or keeps data indefinitely; no meaningful description of security safeguards.
anchors.Medium: Retention described vaguely (e.g. 'as long as necessary'); standard security measures mentioned without specifics.
anchors.Low: Concrete retention limits or deletion schedules; specific safeguards (encryption in transit/at rest, access controls) described.

categories.name: User Rights & Control
categories.definition: What rights users have over their data (access, correction, deletion, portability, opt-outs) and how they can exercise them.

anchors.High: No mechanism to access, correct, or delete data; opt-outs absent or non-functional.
anchors.Medium: Rights exist but are limited (e.g. only where legally required) or exercising them is cumbersome.
anchors.Low: Clear, easy-to-use controls for access, deletion, export, and consent/opt-out, available to all users.

categories.name: AI & Automated Decision-Making
categories.definition: Use of personal data for automated decisions, profiling, or AI/ML, including model training.

anchors.High: Uses personal data to train AI models or make consequential automated decisions without opt-out or human review.
anchors.Medium: Profiling or automated personalization disclosed; opt-out or human review available on request.
anchors.Low: No automated decision-making with significant effects, or it is clearly disclosed with meaningful user control; personal data not used for model training.

categories.name: Policy Changes & Updates
categories.definition: How the service notifies users of policy changes and whether changes apply to previously collected data.

anchors.High: May change the policy at any time without notice; continued use counts as consent; changes may apply retroactively.
anchors.Medium: Notice of changes given (e.g. posting or email) but acceptance is implied by continued use.
anchors.Low: Advance notice of material changes with clear effective dates; consent obtained before significant changes apply.
